title: Bill Colby's death before delivering a zero-point device

tellings.quote: You know, when Bill KBY, who had been read into this, tried to get a zero point device to us

plain: A man named William Colby, who had been "read into" the secret, meaning given access to it, tried to get a zero-point device, a machine said to draw energy from empty space, to a man named Steven Greer and his group, and died in 1996 in a river south of Washington before it reached them. Greer tells Michels this as someone directly involved, and in his telling the timing of the death is the point.
